aboutGame.title: What is Superhero Arena?
paragraphs: Superhero Arena is a Roblox action battlegrounds and fighting game from The Duelists. Players choose a hero, battle rivals in servers of up to 15, and defeat other players to unlock additional heroes, with Thanos presented as the long-term warlord goal.

The official Roblox page names Spider-Man, Iron Man, Aquaman, Deadpool, and more as playable examples, and documents Q as the Dash control. Superhero Arena is available through Roblox on Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Xbox, and PlayStation.

faq.title: Superhero Arena FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Superhero Arena.

items.question: What is Superhero Arena?
items.answer: Superhero Arena is a Roblox action battlegrounds and fighting game from The Duelists. Players choose a hero, fight rivals in servers of up to 15, and defeat players to unlock new heroes, with Thanos as the named long-term goal.

items.question: How do you unlock heroes in Superhero Arena?
items.answer: Defeat other players. The official Roblox page confirms that defeating players unlocks new heroes and names Thanos as the warlord goal, while exact thresholds and unlock order are not listed.

items.question: Does Superhero Arena have codes?
items.answer: The official Roblox page lists no active Superhero Arena codes or code-entry menu as of October 29, 2026. Avoid third-party generators and never share Roblox account details.

items.question: What controls does Superhero Arena use?
items.answer: Q is the documented Dash control in Superhero Arena. The official Roblox page does not list basic attack, hero ability, or flight bindings.

items.question: Is Thanos the strongest hero in Superhero Arena?
items.answer: Roblox describes Thanos as the warlord and long-term unlock goal in Superhero Arena. The page publishes no stats or hero rankings, so no official strongest-hero ranking exists.
